==English==

===Pronunciation===
* {{IPA|en|/ˈfɪʃɪŋ/}}
* {{audio|en|En-us-fishing.ogg|a=US}}
* {{rhymes|en|ɪʃɪŋ|s=2}}
* {{homophones|en|phishing}}

===Etymology 1===
From {{inh|en|enm|fischynge}}, equivalent to {{suffix|en|fish|ing}}.
{{wp}}

====Noun====
{{en-noun|~}}
[[Image:Stilts fishermen Sri Lanka 02.jpg|right|thumb|[[stilt|Stilt]] [[fishermen]] in [[Sri Lanka]].]]

# {{lb|en|uncountable}} The [[act]] of [[catch]]ing [[fish]].
#: {{ux|en|We had a good day's '''fishing''' at the weekend.}}
#* {{quote-book|en|year=1922|author=w:Michael Arlen|title=[http://openlibrary.org/works/OL1519647W “Piracy”: A Romantic Chronicle of These Days]|chapter=3/19/2
|passage=Ivor had acquired more than a mile of '''fishing''' rights with the house ; he was not at all a good fisherman, but one must do something ; one generally, however, banged a ball with a squash-racket against a wall.}}
# {{lb|en|uncountable|informal}} The [[act]] of [[catch]]ing [[other]] [[form]]s of [[seafood]], [[separately]] or [[together]] with [[fish]].
# {{senseid|en|business of catching fish}}{{lb|en|uncountable}} [[commercial|Commercial]] fishing: the [[business]] or [[industry]] of [[catch]]ing [[fish]] and [[other]] [[seafood]] for [[sale]].
#: {{ux|en|This is good news for the '''fishing''' industry.}}
# {{lb|en|countable}} A [[fishery]], a [[place]] for [[catch]]ing [[fish]].
#* {{RQ:Spenser Ireland
|passage=the rent of the '''fishings'''}}
#* {{quote-book|en|year=1917|title=The Scots Law Times|volume=2|page=190
|passage=Generally speaking, the only '''fishings''' which appear separately in Valuation Rolls as having a lettable value in their actual state from year to year are salmon-fishings.}}

* {{sense|act}} {{l|en|piscatology}}, {{l|en|piscation}}, {{l|en|piscicide}} {{qualifier|pejorative}}, [[piscicapture]], the [[gentle craft]]
